definitions.gloss: suspicion of a crime; charge; accusation
definitions.explanation: Suspicion that someone has committed a crime, or the formal charge brought against them. A legal and journalistic term frequently seen in news reports.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窃盗|せっとう}→窃盗：15280_settou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{嫌疑|けんぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かけられた。
{嫌疑|けんぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{晴|は}れて→晴れる：00701_hareru⟧⟦{釈放|しゃくほう}→釈放：14806_shakuhou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The suspicion was cleared and they were released.

examples.japanese: ⟦{殺人|さつじん}→殺人：13236_satsujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{嫌疑|けんぎ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{容疑|ようぎ}→容疑：12317_yougi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{否認|ひにん}している→否認する：22511_hininsuru⟧。
examples.english: The man arrested on suspicion of murder denies the charges.

notes:
A formal and legal term, mostly in news reports and legal writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {嫌疑|けんぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かける: to cast suspicion on
- {嫌疑|けんぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{晴|は}れる→晴れる：00701_hareru⟧: the suspicion is cleared
- {嫌疑|けんぎ}⟦{不十分|ふじゅうぶん}→不十分：05616_fujuubun⟧: insufficient evidence (a reason not to prosecute)
- {嫌疑|けんぎ}なし: no grounds for suspicion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{容疑|ようぎ}→容疑：12317_yougi⟧: suspicion of a crime; the everyday news word, as in ⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧ (suspect)
- ⟦{被疑者|ひぎしゃ}→被疑者：22237_higisha⟧: suspect (the legal term)

WATCH OUT:
Homophone: ⟦{建議|けんぎ}→建議：08791_kengi⟧ (a formal recommendation to the authorities).
